headline: 新片热剧齐燃，银幕荧屏双响
summary: 今日电影市场由《生死时限》领跑，温情之作《给阿嬷的情书》亦受关注；电视端新剧《狂热先生》首播，热播剧《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续霸榜。待映待播项目蓄势待发。

industryHighlights.text: 《生死时限》成今日院线热门，口碑票房双领跑。
industryHighlights.en: "Deadline" leads today's theaters in both buzz and box office.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《狂热先生》首播，引发观众热议。
industryHighlights.en: New series "Mr. Fanatic" premieres to heated discussion.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》稳居热播榜首。
industryHighlights.en: "House of the Dragon" remains the top hit series.

industryHighlights.text: 多部待映/待播作品蓄势，影市剧集储备充足。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films and series build strong momentum for the market.

headlineEn: New Movies and Hot Series Ignite Screens
summaryEn: Today's box office is led by "Deadline" while heartfelt "A Letter to Grandma" draws attention; TV sees premiere of "Mr. Fanatic," and "House of the Dragon" keeps dominating. New films and shows are on the way.
